# virtualbox_network (Resource)

Manages a VirtualBox Host-Only network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "virtualbox_network" "example" {
  name          = "example-network"
  network_cidr  = "192.168.56.0/24"
  dhcp          = true
  dhcp_lower_ip = "192.168.56.100"
  dhcp_upper_ip = "192.168.56.200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the host-only network.
- `network_cidr` (String) The network CIDR (e.g., '192.168.56.0/24'). Required by VBoxManage to derive the netmask.

### Optional

- `dhcp` (Boolean) Enable the host-only network (DHCP). Defaults to true.
- `dhcp_lower_ip` (String) Lower bound of the DHCP IP range. Defaults to the first usable address in network_cidr.
- `dhcp_upper_ip` (String) Upper bound of the DHCP IP range. Defaults to the last usable address in network_cidr.

### Read-Only

- `guid` (String) The GUID of the network.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Host-only networks are imported by name.
terraform import virtualbox_network.example example-network
```
